title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1,351–1,400 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: Tai Tzu-ying is a world-class badminton athlete from Taiwan.
examples.zh: 戴資穎是來自台灣的世界級羽球運動員。

examples.en: Professional athletes train several hours each day to stay in peak physical condition.
examples.zh: 職業運動員每天訓練數小時以維持在最佳體能狀態。

examples.en: Student athletes must balance demanding study schedules with varsity team practices.
examples.zh: 學生運動員必須在繁重的課業時程與校隊集訓之間取得平衡。

examples.en: Our school basketball team became the city champion.
examples.zh: 我們學校的籃球隊奪得了全市冠軍。

examples.en: She was crowned the national chess champion after an undefeated season.
examples.zh: 她在整個賽季保持不敗後榮膺全國西洋棋冠軍。

examples.en: Martin Luther King Jr. was a fearless champion of civil rights and equality.
examples.zh: 馬丁·路德·金恩博士是民權與平權運動無畏的倡導捍衛者。

examples.en: Hundreds of schools competed in the national high school baseball tournament.
examples.zh: 數百所學校參加了全國高中棒球錦標賽（黑豹旗）。

examples.en: The tennis tournament was delayed until the courts dried completely.
examples.zh: 網球錦標賽被迫暫停延後，直到球場完全乾燥為止。

examples.en: Our debate team advanced to the semi-finals of the intercollegiate tournament.
examples.zh: 我們的辯論隊晉級到了跨校辯論錦標賽的準決賽。

examples.en: The coach encouraged players to stay focused during the final minutes.
examples.zh: 教練激勵球員在最後幾分鐘保持專注。

examples.en: We boarded a luxury air-conditioned coach for the day trip to Taichung.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘一輛豪華冷氣長途巴士前往台中一日遊。

examples.en: She coaches junior tennis players at the local sports complex every weekend.
examples.zh: 每個週末她在當地運動中心指導青少年網球選手。

examples.en: The referee blew his whistle to signal the end of the match.
examples.zh: 裁判鳴笛吹響哨音示意比賽結束。

examples.en: Both team captains respectfully shook hands with the match referee.
examples.zh: 兩隊隊長恭敬地與執法裁判握手致意。

examples.en: Academic papers are evaluated by independent referees before peer-reviewed publication.
examples.zh: 學術論文在同儕審查發表前會由獨立審查人進行評審。

examples.en: Teamwork and trusting your teammates lead to victory.
examples.zh: 團隊合作與信任隊友能導向最後勝利。

examples.en: He passed the basketball quickly to an open teammate under the hoop.
examples.zh: 他迅速將籃球傳給籃下無人防守的隊友。

examples.en: Teammates celebrated together with joyful high-fives and loud cheers.
examples.zh: 隊友們高興地互相擊掌並大聲歡呼慶祝。

examples.en: Always show respect to your opponent after the match.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後務必展現對對手的尊重。

examples.en: His political opponent criticized the newly announced tax policy.
examples.zh: 他的政治對手批評了新公布的稅收政策。

examples.en: She studied her opponent's game footage carefully to identify weak spots.
examples.zh: 她仔細研究對手的比賽錄影以找出弱點破綻。

examples.en: Athletes from over fifty nations compete in the World Games.
examples.zh: 來自五十多個國家的運動員在世運會中同台競技。

examples.en: Local bookstores find it difficult to compete against giant e-commerce platforms.
examples.zh: 實體書店發現很難與龐大的電商巨頭平台相抗衡競爭。

examples.en: Siblings often compete for their parents' attention and praise.
examples.zh: 兄弟姊妹經常互相競爭以博取父母的關注與讚許。

examples.en: She won first prize in the English speech competition.
examples.zh: 她在英語演講比賽中榮獲第一名。

examples.en: Fierce market competition led to significant price cuts for consumers.
examples.zh: 激烈的市場競爭為消費者帶來了大幅的價格折扣。

examples.en: Entry into the prestigious design competition is completely free of charge.
examples.zh: 報名參加這項負有盛名的設計競賽是完全免費的。

examples.en: Table tennis is a highly competitive sport in Asia.
examples.zh: 桌球在亞洲是一項競爭非常激烈的運動。

examples.en: To stay competitive, businesses must innovate and adopt modern technologies.
examples.zh: 為了保持競爭力，企業必須持續創新並採用現代科技。

examples.en: He has an intensely competitive spirit and always strives to win.
examples.zh: 他擁有極強的好勝心，總是全力爭取勝利。

examples.en: What is the final score of the baseball game?
examples.zh: 這場棒球比賽的最終比分是多少？

examples.en: The young striker scored the winning goal in the final ninety seconds.
examples.zh: 年輕前鋒在最後九十秒踢進了致勝得分球。

examples.en: The composer wrote a haunting orchestral score for the movie soundtrack.
examples.zh: 作曲家為電影原聲帶編寫了一首扣人心弦的管弦樂配樂。

examples.en: A three-point shot in basketball can change the game rapidly.
examples.zh: 籃球裡的三分球能迅速改變比賽局勢。

examples.en: She raised an important point during the board meeting discussion.
examples.zh: 她在董事會議討論中提出了一個至關重要的觀點。

examples.en: The guide pointed toward the historic lighthouse standing on the cliff.
examples.zh: 導遊指向佇立在懸崖上的歷史悠久燈塔。

examples.en: The entire crowd cheered loudly for the team's dramatic victory.
examples.zh: 全場觀眾為球隊戲劇性的勝利大聲歡呼。

examples.en: Hard work and resilience led the underdog team to an unexpected victory.
examples.zh: 刻苦努力與韌性帶領這支不被看好的隊伍贏得了意外的勝利。

examples.en: The army celebrated a decisive victory after months of harsh battle.
examples.zh: 經過數月慘烈戰鬥後，軍隊慶祝了一場決定性的重大勝利。

examples.en: Our soccer team defeated the reigning champions 2 to 1.
examples.zh: 我們的足球隊以二比一擊敗了衛冕冠軍。

examples.en: Accepting defeat gracefully is an essential part of true sportsmanship.
examples.zh: 展現風度坦然接受挫敗是真正運動家精神的核心要素。

examples.en: Heavy monsoon rain defeated our hopes for an outdoor camping trip.
examples.zh: 傾盆的季風暴雨挫敗了我們進行戶外露營的期盼。

examples.en: The exciting volleyball match ended in a 2-2 tie.
examples.zh: 這場精彩的排球賽最終以二比二打成平手。

examples.en: He wore a crisp white dress shirt with a handsome silk tie.
examples.zh: 他身穿筆挺白襯衫並繫著一條帥氣的真絲領帶。

examples.en: Remember to tie your shoelaces tightly before heading out for a run.
examples.zh: 出門跑步前記得把鞋帶繫緊。

examples.en: Taipei Dome is a modern indoor stadium for baseball and concerts.
examples.zh: 台北大巨蛋是用於棒球賽與演唱會的現代室內體育館。

examples.en: Over fifty thousand passionate fans packed into the Olympic stadium.
examples.zh: 超過五萬名熱血球迷湧入並坐滿了奧運體育場。

examples.en: Security guards checked bags at every gate entrance of the football stadium.
examples.zh: 保全人員在足球體育場的各個大門出入口仔細查驗隨身包包。

examples.en: Students play dodgeball inside the school gym on rainy days.
examples.zh: 雨天時學生在學校體育館內玩躲避球。

examples.en: He hits the fitness gym three times a week to lift weights and stay healthy.
examples.zh: 他每週去三次健身房重訓以保持身體健康。

examples.en: The membership fee for this 24-hour gym includes access to the sauna.
examples.zh: 這間二十四小時健身房的會費包含了三溫暖設施的使用權。

examples.en: We booked a wooden badminton court for two hours.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了兩個小時的木地板羽球場。

examples.en: The tennis players stepped onto the clay court under bright sunshine.
examples.zh: 網球選手們在燦爛陽光下步入了紅土球場。

examples.en: The suspect appeared before the district court judge this morning.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人今天上午在地區法院法官面前出庭應訊。

examples.en: The groundskeeper mowed the grass on the soccer field.
examples.zh: 場地管理員修剪了足球場上的草皮。

examples.en: She is an internationally recognized expert in the field of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 她是人工智慧領域內享譽國際的知名權威專家。

examples.en: Golden wheat fields swayed gently under the autumn breeze.
examples.zh: 金黃色的麥田在秋風吹拂下輕輕搖曳。

examples.en: Track and field events include sprinting, hurdles, and long jump.
examples.zh: 田徑項目包括短跑、跨欄與跳遠。

examples.en: She won gold medals in two different track and field categories.
examples.zh: 她在兩個不同的田徑競賽項目中皆奪得了金牌。

examples.en: School sports day features exciting track and field relay competitions.
examples.zh: 學校運動會安排了刺激精彩的田徑接力競賽。

examples.en: Thousands of runners participated in the Taipei Marathon.
examples.zh: 數千名跑者參加了台北馬拉松賽事。

examples.en: Training for a 42-kilometer full marathon requires months of endurance discipline.
examples.zh: 為四十二公里的全程馬拉松進行訓練需要數個月的耐力紀律。

examples.en: The committee engaged in a marathon negotiation session that lasted all night.
examples.zh: 委員會進行了一場持續整夜的馬拉松式冗長談判會議。

examples.en: Morning jogging around Daan Forest Park is refreshing.
examples.zh: 清晨在大安森林公園周圍慢跑令人心曠神怡。

examples.en: Put on cushioned running shoes to protect your joints while jogging.
examples.zh: 慢跑時請穿上具避震效果的慢跑鞋以保護關節。

examples.en: She prefers light jogging at dusk when the summer heat begins to fade.
examples.zh: 她偏好在黃昏酷暑漸消時進行輕鬆慢跑。

examples.en: Cycling around Taiwan (Huan Dao) is a popular dream trip.
examples.zh: 單車環島在台灣是一項非常熱門的夢想之旅。

examples.en: Dedicated riverside cycling paths provide scenic and safe riding experiences.
examples.zh: 專屬的河濱自行車專用道提供了風景秀麗且安全的騎乘體驗。

examples.en: Wear bright reflective clothing when cycling after dark.
examples.zh: 夜間騎自行車時請穿著明亮的反光衣物。

examples.en: Swimming is an excellent full-body cardio workout.
examples.zh: 游泳是一項絕佳的全身性有氧運動。

examples.en: Children learn swimming and water safety skills during summer camp.
examples.zh: 孩童在夏令營期間學習游泳技巧與水上安全常識。

examples.en: Swimming against the ocean current can be extremely dangerous.
examples.zh: 逆著海流強行游泳可能極其危險。

examples.en: The community sports center has a heated indoor swimming pool.
examples.zh: 社區國民運動中心設有溫水室內游泳池。

examples.en: Lifeguards monitor swimmers closely at the crowded outdoor swimming pool.
examples.zh: 救生員在人潮擁擠的戶外游泳池旁密切監控泳客安全。

examples.en: The luxury hotel features a stunning rooftop infinity swimming pool.
examples.zh: 這間豪華飯店配有一座令人驚嘆的高空無邊際游泳池。

examples.en: Wear swimming goggles to protect your eyes from pool chlorine.
examples.zh: 佩戴泳鏡以保護雙眼不受泳池氯氣刺激。

examples.en: Chemistry students must wear protective goggles during laboratory experiments.
examples.zh: 化學系學生在實驗室進行實驗時必須佩戴防護護目鏡。

examples.en: Anti-fog swimming goggles give you clear underwater vision.
examples.zh: 防霧泳鏡能讓你在水中擁有清晰的視野。

examples.en: Put on your swimsuit and shower before entering the public pool.
examples.zh: 進入公共泳池前請換上泳衣並先淋浴沖洗。

examples.en: She packed two colorful swimsuits for her beach holiday in Kenting.
examples.zh: 她為墾丁的海灘假期打包了兩套色彩鮮豔的泳裝。

examples.en: Rinse your chlorine-soaked swimsuit with cold tap water after swimming.
examples.zh: 游泳完畢後請用冷自來水沖洗浸滿氯水的泳衣。

examples.en: Badminton is one of the most popular sports in Taiwanese schools.
examples.zh: 羽球是台灣校園中最受歡迎的運動項目之一。

examples.en: Playing badminton improves your agility, stamina, and eye-hand coordination.
examples.zh: 打羽毛球能提升你的敏捷度、體力以及手眼協調能力。

examples.en: We joined the neighborhood badminton club to play doubles every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 我們加入了社區羽球社，固定在每週日早上打雙打。

examples.en: I need to re-string my carbon fiber badminton racket.
examples.zh: 我需要替我的碳纖維羽球拍重新穿線。

examples.en: Grip the tennis racket firmly but keep your wrist flexible.
examples.zh: 緊握網球拍但同時讓手腕保持靈活彈性。

examples.en: The sports store sells professional squash and tennis rackets.
examples.zh: 這家體育用品專賣店販售專業壁球拍與網球拍。

examples.en: Smash the feather shuttlecock across the net with power.
examples.zh: 用力將羽毛球扣殺過網。

examples.en: Plastic shuttlecocks are durable and ideal for casual backyard play.
examples.zh: 塑膠羽毛球經久耐用，非常適合庭院休閒對打。

examples.en: The referee examined the tournament shuttlecock for damaged duck feathers.
examples.zh: 裁判檢查了比賽用球是否有破損的鴨毛羽管。

examples.en: Table tennis requires quick reflexes and sharp concentration.
examples.zh: 桌球需要敏捷的反應能力與高度專注力。

examples.en: Lin Yun-ju achieved outstanding results in international table tennis championships.
examples.zh: 林昀儒在國際桌球錦標賽事中取得了非凡出色的戰績。

examples.en: There are four green table tennis tables inside the community recreational center.
examples.zh: 社區休閒活動中心內設有四張綠色的桌球桌。

examples.en: He grips his table tennis paddle using the penhold style.
examples.zh: 他以直拍握法握住他的桌球拍。

examples.en: We used long wooden paddles to navigate the kayak down the river.
examples.zh: 我們使用長木槳划著獨木舟順流而下。

examples.en: Replace the rubber sheet on your table tennis paddle when it loses grip.
examples.zh: 當桌球拍膠皮失去摩擦抓球力時應予更換。

examples.en: We played beach volleyball during our seaside holiday in Kenting.
examples.zh: 我們在墾丁海邊度假時打了沙灘排球。

examples.en: The setter delivered a perfect pass for the middle blocker to spike the volleyball.
examples.zh: 舉球員送出了一記完美傳球，讓快攻手強勢扣殺排球。

examples.en: Team communication is essential on the volleyball court.
examples.zh: 排球場上的團隊溝通呼應至關重要。

examples.en: Elementary students love playing energetic dodgeball games during recess.
examples.zh: 國小學生下課時間非常喜歡玩活力充沛的躲避球。

examples.en: He ducked swiftly to avoid being hit by the incoming dodgeball.
examples.zh: 他敏捷地低頭蹲下以避開飛來的躲避球。

examples.en: Dodgeball teaches children rapid agility, throwing accuracy, and team cooperation.
examples.zh: 躲避球運動教導孩子們敏捷的身手、投球準頭與團隊默契。

examples.en: Catch the high fly ball securely with your baseball glove.
examples.zh: 用你的棒球手套穩穩接住高飛球。

examples.en: Applying leather oil helps soften and break in a new baseball glove.
examples.zh: 塗抹皮革保養油有助於軟化並馴開全新棒球手套。

examples.en: My dad handed down his cherished vintage baseball glove to me.
examples.zh: 父親將他珍藏的古董復古棒球手套傳承給了我。

examples.en: The batter hit a spectacular grand-slam home run!
examples.zh: 打擊者擊出了一支精彩絕倫的滿貫全壘打！

examples.en: The baseball sailed over the outfield wall for a thrilling solo home run.
examples.zh: 棒球飛越了外野全壘打牆，形成了一記令人熱血沸騰的陽春全壘打。

examples.en: The sales campaign was a massive home run that exceeded all revenue forecasts.
examples.zh: 這次行銷活動大獲全勝，徹底超越了所有的營收預期。

examples.en: The ace pitcher recorded ten strikeouts during tonight's game.
examples.zh: 王牌投手在今晚的比賽中投出了十次三振。

examples.en: The batter swung and missed on a curveball, resulting in a strikeout.
examples.zh: 打擊者揮棒落空於變化球，吞下了三振出局。

examples.en: Striking out with the bases loaded was a heartbreaking moment for the home team.
examples.zh: 滿壘時遭到三振出局對主場球隊而言是個令人心碎的時刻。

examples.en: The referee called a personal foul on the defensive player.
examples.zh: 裁判吹判防守球員一次個人犯規。

examples.en: The batter fouled the fastball into the spectator stands behind home plate.
examples.zh: 打擊者將快速直球擊成界外球，飛入了本壘後方的觀眾席。

examples.en: There was a foul, pungent smell emanating from the clogged kitchen drain.
examples.zh: 堵塞的廚房排水孔散發出一陣陣難聞刺鼻的惡臭味。

examples.en: The striker scored a goal from the penalty spot.
examples.zh: 前鋒在十二碼罰球點操刀破門得分。

examples.en: Late payment of property taxes incurs a steep monetary penalty.
examples.zh: 逾期繳納房屋地價稅將會面臨高額的金錢處罰滯納金。

examples.en: The hockey player spent two minutes in the penalty box for tripping an opponent.
examples.zh: 這位曲棍球選手因為絆倒對手而被判在受罰席受罰兩分鐘。

examples.en: Always warm up properly for ten minutes before rigorous exercise.
examples.zh: 進行劇烈運動前務必充分熱身十分鐘。

examples.en: The orchestra played gentle scales to warm up their instruments before the concert.
examples.zh: 管弦樂團在音樂會前演奏平緩音階來為樂器暖身熱機。

examples.en: Drink a cup of hot ginger soup to warm yourself up after being out in the cold.
examples.zh: 在外頭受凍後，喝杯熱生薑湯讓身體溫暖起來。

examples.en: Jog slowly and stretch to cool down after running laps.
examples.zh: 跑步圈數結束後慢跑並伸展以進行緩和運動。

examples.en: Let the baked pie cool down on the wire rack for twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 讓烘烤完成的餡餅在冷卻架上靜置散熱二十分鐘。

examples.en: Take a few deep breaths to cool down when you feel angry.
examples.zh: 當你感到憤怒時，深呼吸幾次讓自己冷靜下來。

examples.en: Stretch your leg muscles to prevent painful cramps.
examples.zh: 伸展腿部肌肉以預防痛苦的抽筋。

examples.en: A long highway stretch of road connects the two northern coastal towns.
examples.zh: 一條綿延漫長的公路路段連接了這兩座北部沿海城鎮。

examples.en: Elastic workout fabrics easily stretch to fit all body shapes comfortably.
examples.zh: 高彈力運動布料能輕鬆延展以舒適貼合各種身形。

examples.en: Strength training builds strong bone density and muscle mass.
examples.zh: 重量訓練有助於提升骨質密度與肌肉量。

examples.en: He pulled a thigh muscle during the soccer match sprint.
examples.zh: 他在足球賽衝刺時不慎拉傷了大腿肌肉。

examples.en: The tech giant used its market muscle to negotiate favorable supplier deals.
examples.zh: 這家電商科技巨頭運用其市場實力優勢洽談了優惠的供應商合約。

examples.en: Doing twenty push-ups every morning strengthens chest muscles.
examples.zh: 每天早上做二十個伏地挺身能鍛鍊胸部肌肉。

examples.en: Keep your back straight and core engaged while performing push-ups.
examples.zh: 做伏地挺身時請保持背部挺直並收緊核心肌群。

examples.en: He increased his daily workout to fifty consecutive push-ups.
examples.zh: 他將每日訓練量提高到連續做五十個伏地挺身。

examples.en: Sit-ups are effective for strengthening abdominal core muscles.
examples.zh: 仰臥起坐對強化腹部核心肌群非常有效。

examples.en: Don't pull on your neck with your hands when doing sit-ups.
examples.zh: 做仰臥起坐時切勿用雙手過度拉扯頸部。

examples.en: The military fitness test requires sixty sit-ups within two minutes.
examples.zh: 國軍體能測驗要求在兩分鐘內完成六十個仰臥起坐。

examples.en: He practiced on the playground bar to master five pull-ups.
examples.zh: 他在遊樂場單槓上練習以達成連續拉五下引體向上。

examples.en: Pull-ups are a supreme test of upper-body pulling strength.
examples.zh: 引體向上是對上半身拉力的極致考驗。

examples.en: Installing a doorway pull-up bar allows you to exercise easily at home.
examples.zh: 在門框上安裝室內引體向上單槓讓你能在家輕鬆鍛鍊。

examples.en: Proper squats strengthen thigh muscles and glute strength.
examples.zh: 正確的深蹲能強化大腿肌力與臀部力量。

examples.en: The catcher stayed in a low squat position behind home plate.
examples.zh: 捕手在本壘板後方始終保持低姿勢蹲捕狀態。

examples.en: Squatting with heavy barbells requires flawless posture to prevent knee strain.
examples.zh: 扛著沉重槓鈴深蹲需要無可挑剔的標準姿勢以防膝蓋受傷。

examples.en: Lift light dumbbells to tone shoulder and arm muscles.
examples.zh: 舉起輕量啞鈴來緊實肩膀與手臂線條。

examples.en: She bought an adjustable dumbbell set for her home workout space.
examples.zh: 她為居家運動空間添購了一套可調節重量的啞鈴組合。

examples.en: The gym provides a wide rack of dumbbells ranging from two to thirty kilograms.
examples.zh: 健身房配有整排從兩公斤到三十公斤不等齊全的啞鈴架。

examples.en: Practicing morning yoga improves flexibility and reduces mental stress.
examples.zh: 練習晨間瑜伽能提升身體柔軟度並減輕心理壓力。

examples.en: Unroll your non-slip rubber yoga mat in a quiet, well-ventilated room.
examples.zh: 在安靜且通風良好的房間內攤開你的防滑橡膠瑜伽墊。

examples.en: Yoga breathing techniques help promote mindfulness and mental calm.
examples.zh: 瑜伽呼吸技巧有助於促進正念冥想與內心平靜。

words.definition: 健行；遠足；登山步道健行

examples.en: Hiking Elephant Mountain rewards visitors with a stunning Taipei view.
examples.zh: 健行象山步道能回報遊客絕美的台北全景。

examples.en: Wear sturdy waterproof boots when going hiking on mountain trails.
examples.zh: 前往高山登山步道健行時請穿著堅固防水的登山靴。

examples.en: Hiking through cedar forests is wonderful for improving lung capacity and peace of mind.
examples.zh: 在杉木森林中漫步健行對提升肺活量與沉澱心靈大有裨益。
